headline: Executive order aims to speed up and coordinate federal environmental reviews and permits for infrastructure projects.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets rules meant to make federal agencies more disciplined and accountable when they do environmental reviews and issue permits for infrastructure projects. It focuses on how agencies handle and manage that review and permitting process. No official summary was provided, so specific deadlines or requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that review and permit infrastructure projects
who_it_affects.how: They are expected to follow new accountability and process rules when handling environmental reviews and permits.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and governments building infrastructure such as roads, bridges, pipelines, or power lines
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how their projects move through federal environmental review and permitting.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed August 15, 2017; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
